policies.title: No same-day guarantees
policies.text: Agents must never guarantee same-day refunds.

policies.title: Honor supervisor requests
policies.text: If a customer requests a supervisor, agents must honor the request immediately.

cases.name: Refund estimate without a guarantee

turns.text: When should I expect my refund?
Refunds usually take five to seven business days. I can check the status for you.

cases.purpose: A refund estimate without a guarantee should not trigger the refund-promise rule.

cases.name: No timing guarantee

turns.text: Refunds usually take five to seven business days.

cases.purpose: A typical refund timeframe is allowed. The rule prohibits guaranteed same-day completion.

cases.name: Explicit forbidden guarantee

turns.text: I guarantee a same-day refund.

cases.purpose: An explicit same-day refund guarantee should violate the fictional refund-promise rule.

cases.name: Promise refund today

turns.text: I promise your refund will arrive today.

cases.purpose: Promising that the refund will arrive today should match the same-day guarantee rule.

cases.name: Explicitly refuses guarantee

turns.text: I cannot guarantee a same-day refund.

cases.purpose: Refusing to guarantee a same-day refund must not be mistaken for making that guarantee.

cases.name: Promise of no refund

turns.text: I promise no same-day refunds.

cases.purpose: A promise of no same-day refunds is not a promise that a refund will arrive today.

cases.name: Reported promise

turns.text: The last agent said I guarantee a same-day refund.

cases.purpose: An agent reporting an earlier promise must not be treated as making a new promise.

cases.name: Caller statement is not agent promise

turns.text: I guarantee a same-day refund.
Please explain the issue.

cases.purpose: The refund rule governs agent promises. The caller saying the same words is not an agent violation.

cases.name: No configured policies

turns.text: I guarantee a same-day refund.

cases.purpose: Without an enabled company rule, a refund promise cannot be confirmed as a policy violation.

cases.name: Inferred agent needs review

turns.text: I guarantee a same-day refund.

cases.purpose: The forbidden wording is present, but inferred speaker attribution must downgrade it to review.

cases.name: Unknown speaker cannot confirm

turns.text: I guarantee a same-day refund.

cases.purpose: An unknown speaker must never produce a confirmed agent policy violation.

cases.name: Explicit supervisor refusal

turns.text: I want to speak to a supervisor.
I cannot transfer you to a supervisor.

cases.purpose: A caller requests a supervisor and the agent explicitly refuses, contradicting the escalation rule.

cases.name: Supervisor transfer offered

turns.text: I want to speak to a supervisor.
I will connect you to a supervisor now.

cases.purpose: Offering the requested supervisor transfer must not be flagged as a refusal. Actual transfer completion is unverified.

cases.name: No transfer log proves nothing

turns.text: I want to speak to a supervisor.
Please hold while I check.

cases.purpose: A missing transfer log does not prove that an agent refused a supervisor request.

cases.name: Billing refusal is not supervisor refusal

turns.text: I want to speak to a supervisor.
I cannot transfer you to billing.

cases.purpose: Refusing a transfer to billing does not establish refusal of the requested supervisor.

cases.name: Offers supervisor after billing refusal

turns.text: I want to speak to a supervisor.
I cannot transfer you to billing, but I will connect you to a supervisor.

cases.purpose: An agent refusing billing but offering the requested supervisor must not trigger the escalation rule.

cases.name: Refusal without request

turns.text: I cannot transfer you to a supervisor.

cases.purpose: This rule requires an explicit caller request. A refusal excerpt alone is insufficient to establish this violation.

cases.name: Caller withdraws request

turns.text: I want to speak to a supervisor.
Never mind, I do not need a supervisor.
I cannot transfer you.

cases.purpose: A supervisor request withdrawn by the caller must not remain an outstanding escalation obligation.

cases.name: Completion without external action result

turns.text: I have processed your refund.

cases.purpose: A refund-completion claim needs an external action result. Without it, the claim is unverified, not a confirmed failed refund.

cases.name: Refund request processing is not completed refund

turns.text: I have processed your refund request.

cases.purpose: Processing a refund request is an administrative step, not a claim that the refund itself completed.

cases.name: Approval condition is not completion

turns.text: Your refund is processed only after approval.

cases.purpose: A conditional description of refund processing must not become a claim that a refund already completed.

cases.name: Refund not completed

turns.text: I have not processed your refund.

cases.purpose: Saying the refund has not been processed must not be flagged as a completed-refund claim.

cases.name: Missing transcript
cases.purpose: With no transcript, even an enabled refund rule must yield insufficient evidence.

cases.name: Promise and unverified completion

turns.text: I guarantee a same-day refund. I have completed your refund.

cases.purpose: A forbidden timing promise and an unverified completion claim are different findings in the same agent turn.

cases.name: Assurance of same-day arrival

turns.text: I assure you your refund will arrive today.

cases.purpose: Tests whether assurance wording is recognized as a guaranteed same-day refund. This is a known coverage gap.

cases.name: Request for team lead refused

turns.text: Please let me speak with your team lead.
I will not let you speak with the team lead.

cases.purpose: Tests whether a refused team-lead request is understood as escalation failure. This is a known coverage gap.

cases.name: Completion phrased as money returned

turns.text: The money has been returned to your card.

cases.purpose: Tests whether money returned to a card is recognized as a refund-completion claim. This is a known coverage gap.

cases.name: Polite escalation request refused

turns.text: May I speak to a human, please?
You cannot speak to a human.

cases.purpose: A polite human request followed by an explicit refusal should still trigger the escalation rule.
